verdict.rationale: Raygun's AI Error Resolution sends error context to an LLM (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, GPT-4 by default with your own API key). That context includes the stack trace, environment and affected code, and the AI returns root-cause and fix suggestions in a collaborative chat that can be linked into the error's comments. Missing for 10: no evidence that breadcrumbs or related commits/deployments are fed into the AI analysis, the bring-your-own OpenAI key adds a setup step, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of suggestion quality.
